steps.note: Boiled in a steam-jacketed ghee boiler with constant stirring, hotter (120–140 °C) in southern India, until frothing stops and the curd particles turn golden to brown.
The browned residue is removed by stack or pressure filters or by a centrifuge.

links.name: Technology of ghee making: direct cream, creamery butter, continuous method (e-PG Pathshala / INFLIBNET)

sources.text: The direct-cream method, with the temperatures, the end point and the clearing of the residue, from the first; the second says that cream can be taken straight to ghee, slowly, with a caramelised taste. The first prefers cream of 60–75 % fat.
